scripts.ready: vp check && vp run -r test && vp run -r build
scripts.dev: echo "doesn't work with TanStack Devtools Source Inspector, cannot handle terminal input" && concurrently -i -n web,console,bogey -c auto --kill-others "vp run web#dev" "node tools/cli/src/bin.ts console" "node tools/cli/src/bin.ts watch"
scripts.devn: echo "Sharing over network & with cloudflared" && echo "doesn't work with TanStack Devtools Source Inspector, cannot handle terminal input" && BOGEY_DEV_ALLOWED_HOSTS="${BOGEY_DEV_ALLOWED_HOSTS:+$BOGEY_DEV_ALLOWED_HOSTS,}.trycloudflare.com" concurrently -i -n web,console,bogey,cloudflared -c auto --kill-others "vp run web#dev --host" "node tools/cli/src/bin.ts console" "node tools/cli/src/bin.ts watch" "cloudflared tunnel --url http://localhost:3000"
